🎬 Twenty-Five Twenty-One
📅 2022 · ❤️ Romance/Drama · 🌸 Coming-of-Age · Series

📜 Storyline

In the late 1990s, Na Hee-do is a passionate young fencer who dreams of becoming a great athlete. Baek Yi-jin is the son of a wealthy family whose life changes completely after the financial crisis. While Hee-do fights to achieve her dreams, Yi-jin struggles to rebuild his life from the beginning.

Their paths cross during a difficult time, and an unexpected friendship slowly turns into something deeper. Along with their friends, they experience youth, ambition, laughter, heartbreak and the uncertainty of growing up. Their bond becomes a beautiful part of their lives, even as time begins to take them in different directions.

🎞️ Series Info

🎬 Director: Jung Jee-hyun
✍️ Screenplay: Kwon Do-eun
📖 Based on: Original screenplay

🏢 Production: Studio Dragon · Hwa&Dam Pictures

🎭 Genre: Romance, Drama, Coming-of-Age
⭐ IMDb: 8.6/10
🎵 Music: Various Artists
🏆 Awards: Received multiple nominations and awards for its performances
🌹 Themes: Youth, dreams, friendship, first love, ambition, sacrifice & growing up

💭 The heart of Twenty-Five Twenty-One:

Twenty-Five Twenty-One is a story about the kind of love that becomes a precious part of our youth. It reminds us that not every meaningful relationship is meant to last forever, but that does not make the memories or feelings any less real.

At its heart, the series captures the beauty and sadness of growing up. Some people enter our lives to help us dream, become stronger and discover ourselves, even if life eventually leads us in different directions.

Rockstar❤️
Rockstar is not just a love story - it's the journey of pain turning into passion. Directed by Imtiaz Ali, the film follows Jordan, played by Ranbir Kapoor, a simple boy who believes true art is born from heartbreak.

​What starts as a chaotic college romance slowly becomes an emotional storm of love, separation, fame, and loneliness. Heer, played by Nargis Fakhri, becomes the soul of Jordan's music and madness. Unlike typical romantic films, Rockstar shows how love can heal and destroy someone at the same time.

​The movie became unforgettable because of its raw emotions, deep dialogues, magical music by A. R. Rahman, and Ranbir Kapoor's career-defining performance. Every song feels like a memory you never lived but somehow still miss.
